push.title: W 3-0 vs GPFC Academy | You: 6.1 (worst match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.1 against GPFC Academy, your worst match performance. Rough one. Be a goldfish, keep the lesson.

DID WELL
+ 1 passes (down from your usual 23). Every attack seemed to have your fingerprints on it.
+ Man of the Match, your 4th for us. Player of the match. The trophy suits you.
+ 3-0 win over GPFC Academy. Enjoy it tonight, hunt the next one tomorrow.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Easy money: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into. Promise it's worth it.
- No key passes from 1 passes. Coach's tip: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- Rating came in 1.1 below what your on-ball stats earned. Try it this way: Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press. Clean it up and fly.
- 2.0 below usual. Every streak has a hiccup.
- 6.1 goes down as your worst match performance. Tomorrow writes a better line.

Rondo time: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Today's lessons are tomorrow's strengths. - Coach Lasso
